key_insight: FDE-Gym shifts AI evaluation from clean, predefined tasks to the messy reality of customer delivery. It benchmarks whether agents can clarify ambiguity, operate in live systems, and uncover hidden constraints like forward-deployed engineers do.
problem_solved: Current agent benchmarks mostly test narrow, well-specified tasks from tickets or issue reports, which miss the complexity of real-world delivery work. This paper addresses the gap by creating a benchmark for end-to-end customer delivery in ambiguous, changing environments.
method: Builds FDE-Gym with 95 end-to-end delivery tasks drawn from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors.
Uses industry experts to adapt tasks from real delivery projects into benchmark scenarios.
Evaluates agents in simulated customer-delivery settings that require requirement clarification, live-system interaction, and constraint discovery.
impact: This benchmark gives practitioners a more realistic way to measure whether agents are ready for deployment in customer-facing workflows. It can help teams identify failure modes that standard benchmarks overlook and design better agentic systems for real business use.
